description.en: A one-plugin index source maintained by the author, so that dsh-invest-bundle can be searched for and installed from the Discover tab before the community catalog lists it.
description.zh: 由作者维护的单插件索引源，用来在插件市场的「发现」页直接搜到并安装 dsh-invest-bundle。

title.zh: 投研插件：10 个工具 + 23 个技能 + 四大师 workflow

description.en: DSH-native equity research: search / page extraction / source audit / cross-verification / numeric rigor / channel probe, plus 23 skills adapted from ai-berkshire. Ships a six-phase four-masters workflow (Duan Yongping, Buffett, Munger, Li Lu) whose four agents run in parallel in the workflow panel, a spec-driven chart engine, and a Markdown-to-PDF pipeline that renders a cover, tables, figures, captions and page numbers.
description.zh: DSH 原生投研插件：检索、正文抓取、信源审计、跨源验证、数值严谨工具与通道探测共 10 个工具，外加 23 个技能（改造自 ai-berkshire 的四大师方法）。内置六阶段四大师 workflow —— 段永平/巴菲特/芒格/李录四个 Agent 在 workflow 面板并行推进 —— 再交叉质证、成稿、spec 驱动出图，最后由 Markdown 管线渲染成带封面/表格/图注/页码的图文 PDF。
